definitions.explanation: The moon phase when the right half is illuminated, occurring about a week after the new moon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今夜|こんや}→今夜：01411_konya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{上弦|じょうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧だ。
examples.english: Tonight is a first quarter moon.

examples.japanese: {上弦|じょうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{右半分|みぎはんぶん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{光|ひか}っている→光る：01163_hikaru⟧。
examples.english: A first quarter moon has the right half illuminated.

examples.japanese: {上弦|じょうげん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: It takes about one week from first quarter to full moon.

notes:
{上弦|じょうげん} refers to the first quarter moon phase. The name comes from the shape resembling a bow (⟦{弓|ゆみ}→弓：08430_yumi⟧) with the string on top (⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧).

MOON PHASES IN JAPANESE:
- ⟦{新月|しんげつ}→新月：17599_shingetsu⟧: new moon
- {上弦|じょうげん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧: first quarter moon
- ⟦{満月|まんげつ}→満月：17598_mangetsu⟧: full moon
- ⟦{下弦|かげん}→下弦：23013_kagen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧: last quarter moon (left half illuminated)

MEMORY AID:
- {上弦|じょうげん}: String on top → right side lit (first quarter)
- ⟦{下弦|かげん}→下弦：23013_kagen⟧: String on bottom → left side lit (last quarter)

Note: These terms are used in astronomy, traditional calendars, and sometimes weather forecasts.
